types.label: Expertise
types.summary: Trained skills; standard first ability +1 in related rolls.
types.acquire: Spend 15 XP, justify narratively, slumber; upgrade 10 XP.

types.label: Gift
types.summary: Vampiric powers; up to three innate, more learned from Connections.
types.acquire: Spend 15 XP; innate slumber, otherwise favor Mission one Rank below theirs; upgrade 10 XP.

types.label: Mystery
types.summary: Magic powers and rituals; never innate, always learned like a non-innate Gift.
types.acquire: Spend 15 XP, learn like a non-innate Gift; upgrade 10 XP.

types.label: Edge
types.summary: Resources or assets: richness, faction loyalty, fame.
types.acquire: Spend 15 XP, justify narratively, slumber; upgrade 10 XP.

types.label: Connection
types.summary: Meaningful relationships; standard first ability +1 to interact.
types.acquire: Never bought with XP; create a Connection; upgrade 10 XP.

types.label: Burden
types.summary: Lasting marks of overwhelm; first ability is a negative effect.
types.acquire: Never bought with XP; suffer the third condition in a cascade; upgrade 10 XP.

aspects.name: Academics
aspects.summary: Scholarly knowledge and research; +1 to field research/study Respite rolls (match grants 1 XP), +1 to Secure an Advantage or Compel in the field, +3 Rush from field-related Loose Ends.

aspects.name: Arts
aspects.summary: Artistic skill and sensibility; reroll when creating or presenting art, and XP for memorializing moving or traumatic events.

aspects.name: Athletics
aspects.summary: Running, jumping, climbing and physical feats; free mitigation for botched maneuvers and one specialized feat with a preset action die.

aspects.name: Computers
aspects.summary: Using, programming and hacking digital systems; anonymity breaches, secret files and retrying failed digital rolls.

aspects.name: Deception
aspects.summary: Lying and concealing motives; reinforce lies with actions, improvise excuses and give false identities teeth.

aspects.name: Driving
aspects.summary: Maneuvering and technical knowledge about cars; smooth long drives, dangerous escapes and unnoticeable tailing.

aspects.name: Empathy
aspects.summary: Reading emotions and understanding feelings; preset dice when soothing distress and insight from Stylish reads.

aspects.name: Gunnery
aspects.summary: Shooting and knowledge about guns; spend Rush to line up shots, a reusable cover die and a once-per-scene quickdraw.

aspects.name: Investigation
aspects.summary: Finding clues, solving puzzles and analyzing evidence; press interrogations further and plan intrusions with flashback marks.

aspects.name: Larceny
aspects.summary: Lockpicking, pickpocketing and bypassing security; stealth, planned intrusions and rewards for leaving a trespassing scene.

aspects.name: Melee
aspects.summary: Close-quarters combat, armed or not; probing strikes, adapting your rhythm and overpowering victims.

aspects.name: Nature
aspects.summary: Wilderness navigation and animal understanding; traverse hazards, handle animals and find calm in natural spaces.

aspects.name: Persuasion
aspects.summary: Convincing with truth and reason; retry failed negotiations, witty Rush cooling and a free nightly favor.

aspects.name: Politics
aspects.summary: Navigating political structures; assess power dynamics, a friendly outside organization and rerolls when dealing with authority.

aspects.name: Sex Appeal
aspects.summary: Seduction and sexual performance; a killer nightly outfit, +1 to seduction-driven actions and swayed kisses.

aspects.name: Socialization
aspects.summary: Fitting in, networking and navigating social situations; claim acquaintance, forge one-night bonds and a favorite venue with base Rush +1.

aspects.name: Streetwise
aspects.summary: Criminal underworld and urban survival; local gossip, illegal procurement and disappearing into streets and crowds.

aspects.name: Animality
aspects.summary: Command animals: an undead familiar, speaking with and summoning beasts, richer feeding and possessing an animal's body.

aspects.name: Control
aspects.summary: Dominate minds: one-action commands, longer or ongoing orders and rewriting recent or old memories.

aspects.name: Decay
aspects.summary: Putrefaction and death-like decay: rot matter, wither limbs, freeze mortals corpse-still and absorb life force to heal.

aspects.name: Endurance
aspects.summary: Superhuman physical resistance: a second Health meter, rolling with lost Health and free damage mitigation.

aspects.name: Haunt
aspects.summary: Instill fear, terror and despair: shocks, hallucinations, night-long delusions and paralyzing terror.

aspects.name: Lightness
aspects.summary: Balance, agility, gliding and flight: rerolls on coordination, cat-like agility feats, gliding from heights and true flight.

aspects.name: Magnetism
aspects.summary: Emotional manipulation and supernatural allure: a coolness aura, a mesmerizing wave, engineered trust and devotion.

aspects.name: Might
aspects.summary: Superhuman strength: rerolls on brute force, extreme feats like tearing through steel and frightening displays of power.

aspects.name: Mutation
aspects.summary: Become beasts and elements: take drained animal traits or full shapes, merge with earth and travel as mist.

aspects.name: Shadows
aspects.summary: Command supernatural darkness: reshape shadows, a tangible shadow tentacle, an eavesdropping shadow and a cloud of darkness.

aspects.name: Speed
aspects.summary: Superhuman velocity and reflexes: rerolls on quickness, blink dashes, stolen moments of stopped time and last-second saves with Blood.

aspects.name: Veil
aspects.summary: Vanish and disguise: become unnoticeable in crowds or anywhere, appear as someone else and apply it all to objects.

aspects.name: Vision
aspects.summary: Superhuman intuition and perception: rerolls on senses, reading an object's past, visible auras and prophetic intuitions.

aspects.name: Blood Strength
aspects.summary: Hone the living essence of your blood: stronger powers, a stored vial, Flow Your Blood to slumber instead of losing 1 Blood, and blood blasts.

aspects.name: Blood Transmutation
aspects.summary: Transform blood into other substances: acid, contact venom, a solidified whip and a homunculus beast.

aspects.name: Catoptromancy
aspects.summary: Manipulate reflections and mirrors: see and project through any mirror, mirror portals and asking a mirror for insight.

aspects.name: Fleshcraft
aspects.summary: Reshape your body and its limits: sculpted faces, bone armaments, stolen body-part enhancements and a detached working hand.

aspects.name: Necromancy
aspects.summary: Contact and command ghosts: question demented wraiths, direct nameless ghosts and manifest an obedient corpse.

aspects.name: Vitality
aspects.summary: Bring yourself closer to a living body: easier Appear Alive rolls, nourishment from human food and reduced sunlight harm.

aspects.name: Faction Loyalty
aspects.summary: An active member of your faction: +1 with members, richer missions for its plans, its structures and rerolls when acting on its values.

aspects.name: Following
aspects.summary: Known and admired within a subculture: +1 with fans and their haunts, small favors, ego boosts and revealing your fame.

aspects.name: Wealth
aspects.summary: Lots of disposable money: high-end possessions, rerolled negotiations and bribes, overtipping and luxury places.

aspects.name: Standard first ability
aspects.summary: Every Connection starts with this: +1 when you interact with this person.

aspects.name: Circle insider
aspects.summary: They belong to a group or clique: once per night, learn recent events in their circle or get introduced to an insider.

aspects.name: Mission companion
aspects.summary: They follow you on missions with max Pulse Rank+2 and two Aspects you lack: +1 when they aid you with those abilities.

aspects.name: Free service
aspects.summary: They provide one useful service: once per night, they offer it as a favor without a Compel.

aspects.name: True friend
aspects.summary: Reroll any dice when you Respite with them, Test Your Connection, or Try Your Conscience for protecting them.

aspects.name: Access to a place
aspects.summary: They grant reliable access somewhere you couldn't enter: first entry tonight gives +1 Rush and +1 to your next roll.

aspects.name: Prey finder
aspects.summary: Once per night, ask them to find suitable prey: Failure counts as Flat, and you Feed in a secure place next scene.

aspects.name: Crucial support
aspects.summary: On a Failure in a crucial moment, cling to thoughts of them to reroll any dice; another Failure also costs 3 Clarity.

aspects.name: Reminder of a value
aspects.summary: They taught you a value you held in life: once per night, reroll any dice when acting on it.

aspects.name: Influential reputation
aspects.summary: Their reputation rubs off: +1 to interact with anyone who admires, deeply respects or answers to them.

aspects.name: Branded
aspects.summary: A shameful brand from your authorities: -1 base Rush, an accepting community and a symbolic sacrifice that aids Try Your Standing.

aspects.name: Scarred
aspects.summary: The scar of a severe wound from undeath: -1 base Rush, Rush resilience against the scarring hazard and +1 surviving while Wounded.

aspects.name: Torpid
aspects.summary: Permanently weakened animating power: -1 base Rush, rerolls to pass as a corpse and mitigating all Blood loss with 1 Rush.

aspects.name: Traumatized
aspects.summary: A psyche damaged by endured terrors: -1 base Rush, +1 evading trauma-like situations and a cold, practical mind when In Shock.

aspects.name: Aberration
aspects.summary: Something bizarre and unnerving about you: harder to seem harmless, touching reactions grant XP and +1 to avoid being found.

aspects.name: Carnivore
aspects.summary: Human flesh, not blood, sustains you: a stored Meat meter, feeding on the living kills them by dawn and murder know-how.

aspects.name: Haunted
aspects.summary: Stalked by the resentful ghost of someone you hurt: a ghost die disturbs solitary rolls and can be sent to intervene.

aspects.name: Light Abhorrent
aspects.summary: Damaged by artificial light: Health loss on 6s in bright places, rewards for escaping them and +1 acting in darkness.

aspects.name: Picky
aspects.summary: Intolerant of the taste of most blood: disgusting victims on odd challenge dice, savoring blood for insight and a type that suits you.

aspects.name: Psychic Conduit
aspects.summary: Consumed blood leaves psychic marks: a Psyche die surfaces fragments, meditation fishes for messages and thoughts push outward.

aspects.name: Ravenous
aspects.summary: Always awaken on the brink of starvation: Blood capped at 1 on slumber, rerolls on desperate hunts and keeping up to 2 Blood.

aspects.name: Savage
aspects.summary: Civility worn away: two action dice keep the lowest with etiquette, deliberate breaches keep the highest and restraint pays off.

aspects.name: Uncanny Reflection
aspects.summary: Your reflection sometimes acts on its own: strange mirror incidents cost Rush, frighten mortals with it and +1 fleeing mirror places.

aspects.name: Weak Blood
aspects.summary: No natural powers: trade your innate Gifts for three free abilities, exploit adversaries' powers and learn advanced abilities for free.
